full_prompt_en: A square modernist oil portrait shows a seated woman with a neat black bob and a calm, slightly distant gaze. Her pale face is near the upper center, turned a little to the left, with blue-gray eyes, softly blushed cheeks, and small coral lips. She wears a deep cobalt-blue robe with turquoise trim around the open neckline and cuffs. One pale forearm rests across the lower foreground, while a dark chair back appears behind her shoulders. The background is almost entirely filled by concentric circles, patterned panels, floral shapes, and small decorative figures. A large orange and teal ring encircles her head like a nonliteral halo; to the lower left, a checkerboard arc in yellow, orange, and blue leads toward tiny stylized motifs. Another circular panel on the right contains blocks of mustard, rust, teal, and dark blue. The many forms remain flat and ornamental rather than describing a realistic room. Strong black outlines separate the blue garment and the patterned fields, while the face and hands are modeled more gently. Paint texture is visible in mottled patches and dry brush marks, especially across the cobalt cloth and colored rings. The palette combines burnt orange, turquoise, mustard yellow, ultramarine, cream, and black, with the woman's pale skin providing visual rest. Light is even and soft, so color contrast and design replace dramatic shadow. Circular shapes radiate around the figure, while her upright torso gives the busy surface a stable center. The overall image is decorative yet solemn, combining a direct, modern portrait with the dense visual rhythm of painted folk motifs.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形现代主义油画肖像呈现一位坐着的女子，黑色短发梳理齐整，目光平静而略显遥远。浅色面容位于上方中央附近，稍转向左，眼睛蓝灰，面颊微红，嘴唇小而珊瑚色。她穿深钴蓝色长袍，敞开的领口和袖口有青绿镶边。一只浅色前臂横放在下方前景，深色椅背从肩后露出。背景几乎完全由同心圆、花纹面板、花形和细小装饰人物填满。一道大型橙色与青绿色环形围住她的头，仿佛非写实的光轮；左下方，黄、橙、蓝相间的棋盘弧线引向微小的风格化图案。右侧另一块圆形板面包含芥末黄、锈红、青绿和深蓝色块。众多形体保持平面与装饰性，而不描绘写实房间。强烈黑轮廓分开蓝色衣服与花纹色域，脸和手则塑形得更柔和。斑驳色块和干笔痕中的颜料纹理清楚可见，在钴蓝布料和彩色圆环上尤其明显。色彩结合焦橙、青绿、芥末黄、群青、奶油色与黑色，女子浅肤色让目光得以歇息。光线均匀柔和，色彩对比和设计代替戏剧性阴影。圆形围绕人物放射，直立躯干则为繁忙表面带来稳定中心。整体图像装饰性强却庄重，将直接的现代肖像与绘制民间图案的密集视觉节奏结合。
style_prompt_en: Decorative modernist oil painting flattens depth into overlapping circular bands, patterned panels, and strong outlined shapes. Burnt orange, turquoise, cobalt, mustard, cream, and black alternate in dense but controlled rhythm. A pale, softly modeled central area gives the eye relief from the surrounding ornament. Dry-brush mottling and uneven pigment remain visible inside flat color regions, lending a handmade surface. Even light keeps shadows shallow; contour and color contrast do most of the structural work. Curving rings radiate around a steady upright center, while smaller checkerboard and floral-like marks fill the edges. The whole treatment is solemn and vivid, joining direct figure-like balance with exuberant folk-derived pattern without relying on realistic setting.
style_prompt_zh: 装饰性现代主义油画把深度压平为叠加圆环、花纹面板和强轮廓形体。焦橙、青绿、钴蓝、芥末黄、奶油色与黑色以密集却有控制的节奏交替。浅色、柔和塑形的中央区域让目光从周围装饰中休息。干笔斑驳与不均匀颜料在平坦色区内部仍可见，赋予手工表面。均匀光线让阴影很浅；轮廓和色彩对比承担大部分结构作用。弯曲圆环围绕稳定的直立中心放射，较小棋盘格与似花痕迹填满边缘。整体处理庄重而鲜活，将直接的形体平衡与旺盛的民间图案结合，不依赖写实场景。
theme_en: A dark-haired woman in blue sits against a richly patterned circular folk-art backdrop
theme_zh: 一位黑发蓝衣女子坐在图案繁密的圆形民间艺术背景前
name: Natalia Goncharova
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
